verdict.rationale: Superpowers documents skills as a harness-agnostic source of truth shared across Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Devin CLI, Hermes Agent, Grok Build, and Copilot CLI, with explicit per-harness install commands and a formal porting guide for adding new harnesses, plus explicit acknowledgment that installation differs by harness and must be repeated per harness. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification that the same skill collection behaves identically across multiple simultaneously installed harnesses, and explicit Cursor-specific documentation.
